cases.question: 2025-01的销售额是多少？
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(actual_amount),2) FROM orders WHERE substr(order_date,1,7)=? AND status='已完成'

cases.question: 各品类的销售额从高到低分别是多少？
cases.oracle_sql:
SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal),2) AS v FROM order_items oi
             JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.id
             WHERE o.status='已完成' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY v DESC

cases.question: 各会员等级的订单量从高到低排列？
cases.oracle_sql:
SELECT c.member_level, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o
             JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id=c.id
             WHERE o.status='已完成' GROUP BY c.member_level ORDER BY n DESC

cases.question: 销售额前5的城市是哪些？

             JOIN stores s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE o.status='已完成'
             GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: 抖音渠道的优惠券核销率是多少？
cases.oracle_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.status='已核销' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*1.0/COUNT(c.id),4)
             FROM coupons c JOIN activities a ON c.activity_id=a.id WHERE a.channel=?

cases.question: 家居品类的毛利是多少？
cases.oracle_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal - p.cost_price*oi.quantity),2)
             FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id=p.id
             JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id=o.id
             WHERE p.category=? AND o.status='已完成'
